name: V-21.1 Chevlex light haulcraft
description: The V-21.1 Chevlex light haulcraft, more commonly known as the Fondor Haulcraft after its manufacturer, was a class of starship used for transport manufactured by Fondor Yards Commercial Ventures used during the Imperial Era. Luthen Rael used a modified version of the haulcraft that was also equipped with a Fondor Droid Mod.
